_comment: Edit freely. Everything here is free/local. Paths are relative to the CLIPPING folder unless absolute.

transcription._model_options: tiny | base | small | medium | large-v3. 'small' is the best CPU trade-off. Use 'medium' or 'large-v3' on a GPU.
transcription._language_note: Use 'ar' for Arabic, 'auto' to let Whisper detect.

render._framing_options: center | left | right | face | blur | a decimal 0.0-1.0 = horizontal position of the crop centre

captions._position_options: lower (about 72% down the frame, the standard safe spot) | middle
